name: To Ensnare a Witch
source:
Halloween night 1973 finds warlock Silas Ate with the strongest hunger for power he's ever felt in a long time.

He's already absorbed a few of his classmates' souls with refreshing ease to build onto his own magic...albeit at several costs to his sanity. 

But one more witch's soul on Halloween is one step closer to elevating his magic to newer heights.

He's already committed the ultimate sin of ending the lives of his fellow magical beings multiple times....what's one more to ensnare? 

[From [url=https://sagemintiart.itch.io/to-ensnare-a-witch]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
1973年万圣节之夜，术士塞拉斯·阿特对权力的渴望达到了很长一段时间以来最强烈的程度。

他已经轻松地吸收了一些同学的灵魂，以建立自己的魔法……尽管这会损害他的理智。

但在万圣节，又一位女巫的灵魂距离将魔法提升到新的高度又近了一步。

他已经多次犯下了结束其他魔法生物生命的终极罪孽……还有什么可以诱捕的呢？

[来自[url=https://sagemintiart.itch.io/to-ensnare-a-witch]itch.io[/url]]
